module: Global utility functions of the GE VM, loaded by main.lua (require('ge_utils')) before the extensions. They are accessible everywhere without require: getPlayerVehicle, getObjectByID, getAllVehicles, vehiclesIterator, scenetree, spawnPrefab, castRay, getTimeOfDay/setTimeOfDay, sanitizeVehicleSpawnOptions, translateDistance/translateVelocity, etc. The file also defines the global scenetree (read-only: scenetree.ObjectName returns the scene object) and a module loader (advancedModuleLoader) installed in 2nd position of package.loaders.
usage:
local veh = getPlayerVehicle(0)
if veh then
  local pos = veh:getPosition()
  local hit = castRay(pos, pos - vec3(0,0,5), true, false)
  if hit then log('I','', 'ground at '..hit.pt.z) end
end
for vid, v in vehiclesIterator() do print(vid, v:getJBeamFilename()) end
setTimeOfDay('13:30')
notes: Cache: getPlayerVehicle(player) and getObjectByID(id) memoize their result (internal false, returned as nil). main.lua calls invalidatePlayerVehicles() / invalidateVehicleCache() on every vehicleSpawned, vehicleSwitched, vehicleDestroyed. getAllVehicles() returns the cached table: do not modify it.
vehiclesIterator(ctx) returns (id, object); iteration runs over the cache created on the first call. activeVehiclesIterator keeps only the vehicles with veh:getActive() true.

Defined globals: scenetree (read-only singleton whose __index does findObject), TorqueScriptLua (obsolete call: only logs an error; callNoReturn calls it; exec -> TorqueScript.exec; getBoolVar/getVar/setVar obsolete -> VariableRegistry), moduleLoaderFallback, serializeJsonToFile (= jsonWriteFile, obsolete), string.c_str (backward compatibility).

scenetree table: findObject(name), findObjectById(id), objectExists(id), objectExistsById(id), decalRoadContainsPoint(id, point), findClassObjects(className) (list of names or nil), findSubClassObjects(className), getAllObjects() (names or nil). Any other key is treated as an object name: scenetree.MissionGroup. Writes are ignored.
The position/rotation/scale strings of spawnPrefab for a PrefabV2 are read with the pattern [0-9]*: negative or decimal numbers are not recognized (probable bug; pass vec3/QuatF instead of strings).

Bug/inconsistency: convertVehicleColorsToPaints logs the nonexistent variable 'colors' (instead of colorTable); convertVehicleNameKeysToVehicleIdKeys logs 'vid', which does not exist in this function (nil value in the message).
Bug/inconsistency: canSpawnAnotherVehicle returns true except on PS5/PS5 Pro; when memory is short, the function ends without an explicit return (so it returns nil, not false).
Bug/inconsistency: translateDistance returns nothing if the uiUnitLength setting is neither 'metric' nor 'imperial'; translateVelocity would then fail.
Bug/inconsistency: the getDirs pattern excludes entries containing a dot after a '/', so it ignores folders whose name contains a dot.

Test/dev functions not documented in detail: scenetree_tests, scenetree_test_fields, test_GE_fields, testGBitmap, testZIP, collisionReloadTest, testSounds, test_lua, testRaycasting. Local functions of the file (colorDifference, prefabFilenameToTemplateName, comparisons...) are not exported.
the_high_sea_crap_detector, called by main.lua, looks for .url files at the root whose SHA1 hash is known, and returns true if found (affects the global sailingTheHighSeas).

getTimeOfDay/setTimeOfDay: the TimeOfDay object stores time as a fraction of day offset by 0.5 (hours = ((time+0.5)%1)*24). The functions do the conversion; time in 24 h format. setTimeOfDay accepts 'HH', 'HH:MM', 'HH:MM:SS' or {hours, mins, secs}.

triggerDelayedStartGenerator.desc: Returns a function (via core_jobsystem.wrap) that, once called, runs func in a job; with waitForCleanup, waits 3 render frames to let GPU resources be freed.

func.desc: function to run after the wait

returns.desc: wrapper function to call to start the job

deleteObject.desc: Deletes the scene object with this name if it exists.

prefabIsChildOfGroup.desc: Indicates whether obj is in the SimGroup named groupName, either directly or via its parent prefab.

getOwningPrefab.desc: Walks up the Prefab (v1) parents of obj and returns the topmost prefab.

returns.desc: root prefab, nil if there is none

getOwningPrefabInstance.desc: Same for PrefabV2 instances (Engine.Prefab.findContainingPrefabInstance), returns the topmost instance.

createObject.desc: Creates an object of the C++ class exposed as a global (e.g. 'SimGroup', 'TSStatic') and increments its reference count. Logs an error and returns nil if the class does not exist. You must then call :registerObject(name).

collisionReloadTest.desc: Debug: reloads the collision (be:reloadCollision) and displays the duration in ms.

invalidatePlayerVehicles.desc: Empties the getPlayerVehicle and getObjectByID caches. Called by main.lua on every vehicle spawn, switch or destruction.

getPlayerVehicle.desc: Cached version of be:getPlayerVehicle(player) (avoids generating garbage). Returns the vehicle controlled by the player, or nil.

getObjectByID.desc: Cached version of be:getObjectByID(id): returns the vehicle with the given id.

vehicleSetPositionRotation.desc: Places a vehicle at a position and rotation (quaternion). Logs an error if the vehicle does not exist.

getVehicleColor.desc: Returns the vehicle's main color as a string 'r g b a metallic roughness clearcoat clearcoatRoughness' (values rounded to 0.01). Player vehicle 0 if vehicleID is nil; empty string if not found.

getVehicleColorPalette.desc: Like getVehicleColor but for colorPalette<index> (index 0 or 1 depending on the vehicle), with the current metallic data.

returns.desc: string of 8 values, nil if no vehicle

invalidateVehicleCache.desc: Invalidates the getAllVehicles / vehiclesIterator cache. Called by main.lua.

getAllVehicles.desc: Returns the (cached) list of all BeamNGVehicle objects present in the level.

vehiclesIterator.desc: Generic iterator over all vehicles: for id, veh in vehiclesIterator() do ... end.

activeVehiclesIterator.desc: Like vehiclesIterator but only walks the active vehicles (veh:getActive()).

getClosestVehicle.desc: Finds the active vehicle closest to requesterID and calls back the requesting vehicle's Lua: callbackfct(id, distance) or callbackfct(-1,-1) if none.

callbackfct.desc: name of a function on the requester's VLua side

forEachAudioChannel.desc: Calls callback(name, channel) for each SFXSourceChannel object in the scene.

getAudioChannelsVolume.desc: Returns the current volumes of all audio channels.

setAudioChannelsVolume.desc: Applies volumes to audio channels by name (getAudioChannelsVolume format).

testSounds.desc: Dev test (marked TODO remove): creates test SFXParameterGroup and audio sources.

getObjectByClass.desc: Returns the first scene object of the given class (e.g. 'TimeOfDay').

getObjectsByClass.desc: Returns all the scene objects of the given class (e.g. 'CloudLayer').

getTimeOfDay.desc: Returns the game time (TimeOfDay object), 24 h format. Nil if there is no TimeOfDay object in the scene.

asString.desc: true: 'HH:MM:SS' string; otherwise table {hours, mins, secs}

returns.desc: false if there is no TimeOfDay object; nil otherwise

loadPrefabv2Template.desc: Loads a PrefabV2 prefab file as a model named after its path (/ -> _, _ -> __).

addPrefab.desc: Creates a Prefab object (v1, manual loading) without loading it. Logs an error and returns nil if the name already exists.

spawnPrefab.desc: Creates and loads a prefab in MissionGroup. If the file ends with .prefab.json and describes a PrefabV2 class, instantiates the model (created if needed); otherwise uses addPrefab + load. Enables collision rebuilding if the editor is active.

removePrefab.desc: Unloads and deletes the prefab with this name if it exists.

returns.desc: result of push, or false if not found

pushActionMapHighestPriority.desc: Like pushActionMap but with maximum priority (pushFirst).

returns.desc: result, or false if not found
result, or false if not found

queueCallbackInVehicle.desc: Runs vluaCommand in the vehicle's Lua then calls back the GE function geluaFunctionName with the command's result followed by ...  Prefer the vehicleBridge API when possible.

vluaCommand.desc: Lua expression evaluated on the vehicle side

getSceneWaypointRadius.desc: Radius of a scene waypoint: the largest of the 3 scale components.

checkVehicleProperty.desc: Tests whether the field propertyName of the vehicle's scene object equals value.

setVehicleProperty.desc: Writes the field propertyName of the vehicle's scene object.

getMaxVehicleAmount.desc: Estimates the maximum number of vehicles: number of physical cores, limited by the available memory in GB and by limit.

setMaxVehicleAmountForTraffic.desc: Sets the trafficAmount and trafficParkingAmount settings to (estimated max - 1, minimum 1). Used by the main options.

logMemoryInfo.desc: Logs the RAM statistics (Engine.Platform.getMemoryInfo) at the given log level.

lovLevel.desc: log level ('I','W'...); parameter name as is in the code

canSpawnAnotherVehicle.desc: On PS5/PS5 Pro only, checks that enough memory remains (default 1 GB); otherwise displays a toast, logs and emits onVehicleSpawnBlocked(availableGB, minGB). On other platforms always returns true.

returns.desc: true if possible, nil otherwise (no explicit return)

recordPlayerAction.desc: Records an action in an engine circular buffer, printed to the log on crash or at shutdown; consecutive identical actions are merged.

convertVehicleColorsToPaints.desc: Converts a list of {r,g,b,a} colors into a list of paints (createVehiclePaint + validateVehiclePaint).

createVehiclePaint.desc: Builds a paint table {baseColor={r,g,b,a}, metallic, roughness, clearcoat, clearcoatRoughness}. Default values: white color, metallic 0.2, roughness 0.5, clearcoat 0.8, clearcoatRoughness 0.

getVehiclePaint.desc: Current paint of a vehicle (color and metallic data of the scene object).

validateVehiclePaint.desc: Fills a paint table with the missing default values (modifies and returns the table).

vehicleMetallicPaintDataFromColor.desc: Extracts metallic, roughness, clearcoat, clearcoatRoughness from elements 5 to 8 of a color array.

vehicleMetallicPaintString.desc: Formats 4 values into a string 'metallic roughness clearcoat clearcoatRoughness'.

validateVehicleDataColor.desc: Normalizes a color (string or table of 4 values) into a string 'r g b a' with 2 decimals; default '1 1 1 1'.

getRandomPaint.desc: Picks a paint at random from the model's. With commonPaintProb, favors common real-world colors (white, black, gray, silver, blue, red) by choosing the model's closest paint. Fallback model: 'pessima'.

commonPaintProb.desc: probability 0 to 1 of aiming for a common color (0 by default)

fillVehicleSpawnOptionDefaults.desc: Completes a vehicle spawn options table: resolves config (.pc or name), paints (color/paintName/paint for 1 to 3 colors), the model's default config. Modifies and returns opt.

sanitizeVehicleSpawnOptions.desc: Calls fillVehicleSpawnOptionDefaults, validates the paints, copies licenseText and vehicleName, and computes the default pos/rot: 5 m to the left of the player vehicle and same orientation, or in front of the free camera.

returns.desc: final options (pos vec3, rot quat, paint, paint2, paint3…)

createPlayerSpawningData.desc: Builds the table {model=, options={config, paint, licenseText, vehicleName, pos, rot}} for spawning a player vehicle.

extractVehicleData.desc: Extracts {config, licenseText, color, model, vehicleName} from a scene vehicle, or returns the current campaign's user vehicle if there is one.

returns.desc: data; nil and a warning if the id is invalid

castRay.desc: Slow raycast (Engine.castRay) between two points. Returns nil with no hit, otherwise the engine's table with pt and norm converted to vec3.

renderGeometry.desc: use the render geometry (false by default)

castRayDebug.desc: Like castRay with debug drawing (start/end spheres, green line if hit, red otherwise, normal).

testRaycasting.desc: Dev test: sweeps an animated castRayDebug; call every frame with dtReal.

convertVehicleIdKeysToVehicleNameKeys.desc: Transforms a table keyed by vehicle id into a table keyed by vehicle name ('name' field).

returns.desc: table by name; nil if data is not a table

convertVehicleNameKeysToVehicleIdKeys.desc: Inverse: transforms a table keyed by vehicle name into a table keyed by id.

isOfficialContent.desc: True if the real path starts with the game folder.

isOfficialContentVPath.desc: Same for a virtual path (resolved by FS:getFileRealPath).

isPlayerVehConfig.desc: True if the file is a .pc located in the user's vehicles/ folder (config created by the player).

imageExistsDefault.desc: Returns path if it exists, otherwise fallbackPath or '/ui/images/appDefault.png'.

dirContent.desc: Recursive list of all the content (files) of path via FS:findFiles.

fileExistsOrNil.desc: Returns path if it is an existing file, otherwise nil.

getDirs.desc: List of the subfolders of path over recursiveLevels levels (filters entries that look like files).

getFileSize.desc: Size of a file in bytes (opened with io.open), -1 if unreadable.

escape_magic.desc: Escapes the magic characters of a Lua pattern for literal use.

translateDistance.desc: Converts a distance in m to the unit of the uiUnitLength setting: km/m in metric, mi/ft in imperial. big=true forces the large unit, 'auto' chooses from 1000 m (metric) or 1 mile.

translateVelocity.desc: Converts a speed in m/s to the setting's unit: km/h or m/s (metric), mph or ft/s (imperial). big=true multiplies the value by 3600 for the large units.

big.desc: true for km/h or mph (value x3600 after distance conversion); otherwise m/s or ft/s

tableChooseRandomKey.desc: Returns a randomly chosen key from the table (math.random seeded on the first call).

randomASCIIString.desc: Generates a random string of digits and letters.

stringToTable.desc: Splits a string by a separator (character-class pattern, default '%s' = whitespace); empty fields are ignored.

spaceSeparated4Values.desc: Concatenates 4 values with spaces, reusing an internal table (no allocation).

copyfile.desc: Copies a text file ('r'/'w' modes: can corrupt a binary file on Windows). Returns nil if it cannot be opened.

getDirectories.desc: Lists the immediate subfolders (full paths) of path.

newFPSLimiter.desc: Creates a rate limiter: limiter:update(dt) returns true about targetFPS times per second. Call from onPreRender/onUpdate.

the_high_sea_crap_detector.desc: Detects known .url files at the game root (pirated version); called by main.lua to set sailingTheHighSeas.

getDateTimeUTCString.desc: Current UTC date and time in ISO 8601 format with milliseconds, e.g. 2023-01-01T12:00:00.123Z.

parseISO8601Date.desc: Converts an ISO 8601 string (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.mmmZ) to os.time; milliseconds are ignored and the time zone is the machine's (os.time).

getFunctionParameters.desc: Returns the parameter names of a Lua function (debug.getlocal) and whether it is variadic. Slow.

generateObjectNameForClass.desc: Generates a name objectName + (largest object id of the class + 1).

getComparisonOps.desc: Returns the list of comparison operators {opSymbol, op, opName, opNameLc}: ==, <, >, <=, >=, ~=.

moduleLoaderFallback.desc: Fallback loader called when the default loader does not find a module: can load workbench/panels/... plugins from their literal VFS path.

dumpGfxResourcesMemory.desc: Logs GPU memory by category (Engine.Render.calculateGfxMemory), in MB, for those exceeding 1 MB.

setCEFFocus.desc: OBSOLETE: no longer has any effect, logs an error (at most 5 times).

replace_char.desc: Replaces the character at position pos of str with r.

returns.desc: str with the character at pos replaced by r

scenetree_tests.desc: Dev tests for scenetree (marked to be converted into real unit tests).

scenetree_test_fields.desc: Dev tests for scene object fields.
